title: Pirates
text:
Now that I’ve got blogs up and running let’s get blogging! Thought I’d go through talking about some music related experiences I’ve had in recent memory. When I sat down to go through the videos I’ve posted I started laughing looking at the stuff I was doing only just 9 months ago. I was really eating tinned tuna like crazy haha, and only had access to dingy studios. I’m doing much better now, but I’m still not done.

For those who don’t know, this video was filmed at Pirate Studios(pirate.com) and I have a love-hate relationship with Pirate. On one hand there is no other company offering production studios at such low rate but on the other hand the equipment at these studios isn’t very well kept and often malfunctions - I understand why this is tho as since pirate is an easily accessible self service studio at a mass scale, over time it gets really difficult to clean up after people who don’t respect the space. It's been stressful at times to get work done especially the times I’d try to record but the microphone would start tweaking. Ahhh!

These days I’m thankful it’s not like that anymore, and I hope to never go back! Check out the next blog to see the new level of studios I unlocked.

title: The Qube
text:
Welcome to the Qube! The name of these studios reminds me of the TV game show “The Cube” I used to watch as kid. Qube offers a similar service to Pirate, however Qube(theqube.com) offers a far more luxurious experience - these studios are some of the best in London - sometimes I show up to my sessions early to just hang out in the lobby!

Unlike Pirate there is a higher barrier to entry as the Qube is members only. There not strict tho, they just vet people to make sure that your not a psycho that will disturb the peace, and that you’ll respect the space. As long as they have vacancies and you actually make music they’ll let you in, no matter where you are in your journey which is nice. The price however is qutie steep but it’s a price I’m willing to pay(for now). Watch the video above to see a tour of their site in Elephant and Castle ‘Qube Elephant’!
